text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Yayoi Sho, but as usual, Agnes Tachyon is thinking about her research.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her like this makes me worry if she'll give the race an honest effort or not.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Declaring that she wouldn't slack off for an important race that leads up to the Satsuki Sho, Agnes Tachyon leaves the waiting room.
